Water infrastructure is a critical—but often overlooked—part of our lives. The bipartisan infrastructure law is delivering safer, more efficient water services to our communities.

I got to see that in action at KCK’s Wolcott Treatment plan, the first of its kind in Kansas! https://t.co/2c8FTXpGv8

I’m proud to help deliver new cancer treatment technology, safer water systems, better flood protection, workforce training opportunities, and more to #KS03.

https://t.co/f3f8z971Nv

Great to join @jocogov and #KS03 partners to open the Tomahawk Creek Wastewater Treatment Facility today.

More modern water infrastructure means safer, healthier communities. https://t.co/4BL6RVC0Us

This is why I supported the bipartisan infrastructure law - to help projects like Johnson County’s Nelson Wastewater to:
👷create jobs in #KS03
🚿deliver cleaner, safer water
💵save Kansans money on their water bill

https://t.co/dCSGv65MRQ

Congratulations to our veterans who graduated from the @JohnsonCoDA Kansas Veterans Treatment Court today!

I look forward to seeing what you all accomplish on your paths ahead. https://t.co/6K110mGDJD
Last year, nearly 108,000 Americans lost their lives to drug overdoses. To find more support to aid in recovery, visit https://t.co/T3XuOz1M2l. You are not alone. https://t.co/K3H0jVj6nI

Yesterday, I visited @MirrorIncKansas, one of the largest providers of substance abuse and addiction treatment in Kansas.

Thank you for your work to better the lives of folks in our community. https://t.co/iCYNwnAHqs

Excited to be back in DC meeting with constituents!

I got to chat with Karen from @HarvestersORG about the food and nutrition programs included in the Farm Bill. Excited to continue working on these issues on the House Ag Committee! https://t.co/uIDVMmJ7SP

As of today, I’ve visited all five counties in #KS03 on my Farm Bill listening tour! In WyCo, we talked about the Farm Bill nutrition programs that are benefiting Kansans.

I’ll keep chatting with Kansas' agriculture leaders so I can bring their priorities to Washington. https://t.co/kIOeubzL7u
Read more on my listening sessions, including today’s on nutrition: https://t.co/quZU076roa

Too many Kansans have lost their lives to the fentanyl crisis. That’s why I asked @US_FDA to make Narcan available for over-the-counter sales.

Last month, they answered my call, which will save lives in Kansas and across the country. https://t.co/EjrNYImdqh

Today, I got to help launch Tyler’s House KC's new summer mental wellness programming!

They’re doing great work to support Kansas youth during some of the most emotionally formative years of their lives. Thanks for having me! #MentalHealthMonth https://t.co/Oo5aWrh7ND

Today I spent the morning with @KVCkids, @GovLauraKelly, and @JerryMoran to break ground on a new mental health wellness center in Olathe!

The new facility will help those in #KS03 facing mental health challenges get the support they need, right here at home. https://t.co/7J4QP1DqOR

Really enjoyed hearing from so many leaders working to advance LGBTQ+ equality in the United States and around the world.

I’ll keep working as a Co-Chair of the @EqualityCaucus to ensure equal treatment for all Kansans. https://t.co/ZVT9DzKAz0

I stopped by Valley Hope, a recognized top-performing addiction recovery center, in OP earlier today.

Their team provides patients and families with high-quality treatment while allowing individuals to live at home, maintain family responsibilities, and continue working. https://t.co/O4MvMTrmlh

Today’s workout at EverFit in Shawnee was a blast, especially as so many Kansans have made living healthy a New Year’s resolution. I’m right there with them!

Let's keep supporting #KS03 small businesses, including small gyms, in 2024. https://t.co/SpQxmiQiLM

In between meetings last weekend, I stopped by Jammin' Nutrition in Garnett to try out a protein shake. We have all kinds of small businesses in #KS03, so don’t forget to #ShopLocal! https://t.co/X4VRWIdphC

I’m proud to receive a 100% rating from @HSLegFund on their 2023 Humane Scorecard.

As an advocate for the humane treatment of animals, I look forward to continuing this important work. https://t.co/z8KwRB6QyR

Great to visit De Soto last week and see the impact of federal investments I secured for 2 projects! The new water treatment plant and water tower projects will support the Panasonic EV Battery plant and manage water flow for 9,300 acres of new development, ensuring safety and growth for our community. #MakingADifference

Garnett's water treatment plant, built in the 1930s, no longer meets today’s safety standards.

So, I’m partnering with city officials to build a new plant, ensuring reliable & affordable drinking water.

Investing in modern infrastructure is crucial for our health and safety. https://t.co/PhSWtEVkqm

Thank you to the team at Prairie Paws in Ottawa for the tour of your facility! As an animal love myself,  I’m proud to advocate for the humane treatment of animals in Congress. https://t.co/QwEFv3VqbZ

From modernizing De Soto’s water treatment plant to reconstructing the Kansas Avenue Bridge in WyCo, I’m proud to have worked with local officials to secure much-needed federal investments for communities across #KS03. 
https://t.co/fG6VQ5LXgg

From nutrition programs to transportation assistance, Johnson County Aging and Human Services (@JoCoAHS) is working hard for JoCo residents. I enjoyed hearing about the services they provide for the community! https://t.co/L9M8HdXL5Z

For 60 years, Title X has helped people access birth control and reproductive care.

Now, the Trump Administration is freezing that funding.

I called on @SecKennedy to reverse this harmful decision — immediately. https://t.co/6AaFnmbx5Z

Parents know what's best for their growing families, not insurance companies.

Today, I introduced bipartisan legislation that gives parents control over their newborns' health care and protects families against surprise medical billing.
